snippet.title: Pegfinity - A colorful incremental game blending Pachinko-style satisfaction with tons of upgrades
snippet.description:
Pegfinity is a colorful physics-based incremental where every launch could turn into a chain reaction of combos, upgrades, and pure satisfaction.

Aim, fire, and watch your balls bounce through pegs and slots. Stack combos, rack up points, and chase bigger and bigger scores on a random generated board with tons of chaos. Who doesn't like those numbers to go brrrrrrr?

Between runs, spend your earnings on over 130 upgrades that reshape the board. Unlock more pegs, new rarer peg types, new balls, unique gadgets and stronger slots. Each run makes the next one more rewarding.

A satisfying progression machine

Every run is a fresh puzzle, and your upgrades make each board more powerful. One more launch, one more run, one more upgrade. Every hit is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky bounce away from the big score.

- Over 130 upgrades
- Unlock unique pegs, balls, slots and cool gadgets
- Random generated board - Each run is something new!
- Permanent unlockable Power Ups!
- And of course some biiiiiiiiiiig numbers!

Wishlist Pegfinity on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3947040/Pegfinity/
